discovery.why_invalid_for_forward_execution: The second learned call did not receive the complete first-call artifact and the retained amount differed by arm. Although this was not a generated-token decoder ceiling, it was a project-selected information restriction capable of changing repair quality and arm comparability.
discovery.required_repair: Pass the complete first-call artifact to every learned arm, apply no project-selected character or token restriction to that artifact, count the exact complete repair prompt with the pinned tokenizer, and treat a non-addressable repair prompt as instrument-invalid rather than model- or mechanism-negative evidence.

negative_evidence.reason: No candidate or control call occurred. This is an instrument-design finding only.

maximum_inference: This report proves only that P4V2R2R2 attempt 2 consumed no model calls or tasks before an asymmetric provisional-artifact prompt restriction was identified and that the unchanged task pool may be used once in a prospectively repaired attempt. It supplies no model, mechanism, task, D1, D2, serving, training, or ASI Stack support evidence.
